title: Inside the U.S.-Canadian Trade War
gist: A Warcast podcast episode with Stephanie Carvin and Daisy Johnston unpacks an escalating tariff war between Canada and the United States, sparked by President Donald Trump's 50% tariffs on Canadian imports, and what a de-escalation would require.

insights.claim: U.S. President Donald Trump imposed 50% tariffs on Canadian imports, sparking an escalating tariff war between the United States and Canada.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: A 50% tariff on a top U.S. trading partner is a material macro and cross-border trade shock to watch for supply-chain and CAD/USD effects.
insights.quote: sparked by U.S. President Donald Trump’s 50% tariffs on Canadian imports
insights.locator: the escalating tariff war between Canada and the United States

insights.claim: The U.S.-Canada relationship, historically a close partnership, has moved into open economic conflict over tariffs.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Deterioration between long-standing allies signals durable trade-relationship risk beyond a single tariff round.
insights.quote: how the partnership headed into economic conflict
insights.locator: how the partnership headed into economic conflict

insights.claim: Resolving the U.S.-Canada trade dispute is framed as an open question requiring deliberate effort for the two countries to find their way back.
insights.speaker: War on the Rocks
insights.so_what: Signals no quick off-ramp is assumed, keeping cross-border trade uncertainty elevated.
insights.quote: what it will take for Canada and the United States to find their way back
